rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_input_norm=adjoint_max, ram_clamp_output=True, ram_finetune=False, ram_finetune_epochs=0, ram_finetune_lr=0.0001, ram_disable_multiscale=True, ram_disable_cudnn=False, ram_use_deepinv_tomo=True, ram_sigma=0.005, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, val_n=214, rationale=iter-6 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol): ONE knob ram_use_deepinv_tomo False->True (BASE_ITER=1; all other knobs RETURN to the iter-1 canonical point: ram_input_norm=adjoint_max, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, ram_sigma=0.005, multiscale disabled, finetune OFF). cfg_full audit iters 1-5: the four INFERENCE-SCALAR levers are now all swept and all EXHAUSTED at hr 0.0 -- post-hoc linear blend ram_post_fbp_blend [iter-2], internal prox_l2 DC gain ram_factor [iter-3], denoiser noise-conditioning ram_sigma [iter-4], input-amplitude norm ram_input_norm [iter-5]. ram_use_deepinv_tomo is the LAST untried cfg flag, pinned False since iter-1. SEMANTICS (solver_ram.py): it routes RAMs reconstruction through the deepinv TOMOGRAPHY physics operator (a faithful multi-eval fan-beam data-consistency path) instead of the lightweight prox_l2 path -- the one remaining STRUCTURAL change to whether the frozen foreign prior gets to leverage measurement consistency against the actual v3 fan geometry. Trajectory under corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric: iter-1 SSIM 0.8611 hr 0.0; iter-2 0.8644 hr 0.0 (blend EXHAUSTED); iter-3 0.8968 hr 0.0 PSNR31.58 (prox_l2 gain EXHAUSTED); iter-4 0.9024 hr 0.0 PSNR31.22 (sigma EXHAUSTED); iter-5 0.9071 hr 0.0 PSNR32.80 (input-norm EXHAUSTED). SSIM climbed 0.861->0.907 yet calibrated headroom stayed pinned at EXACTLY 0.0 throughout (baseline LD-FBP SSIM0.8078, oracle HD-FBP 0.9331; RMSE-sensitive metric keeps RAMs ~31-33dB PSNR below the LD-FBP floor). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS not CT pixels): (1) prev: hr 0.0 on all four inference scalars; best SSIM iter-5 0.9071, best hr 0.0. (2) LIMITER: RAM is a frozen pretrained zero-shot deepinv denoiser that never saw real LDCT helical-rebinned 2304-view fan data; on dense full-view Mayo LD-FBP is already a near-complete inversion, so a foreign-prior denoiser can only redistribute/smooth signal, not add LDCT-specific recoverable structure -> its RMSE stays above the LD-FBP floor -> hr pinned at 0 regardless of inference lever. (3) ONE knob: ram_use_deepinv_tomo False->True (the last untried structural lever, the DC physics path). (4) hypothesis: hr stays EXACTLY 0.0 -- routing through the deepinv-tomo physics DC does not move the calibrated metric because the foreign prior carries no LDCT-specific recoverable signal at any DC formulation; predict hr 0. (5) falsifier: if hr at ram_use_deepinv_tomo=True != 0.0 (rises OR drops off the 0.0 floor), RAMs DC physics path DOES move the calibrated metric and RAM is not purely FBP-bounded; if hr stays 0.0 across blend(i2)+prox_l2(i3)+sigma(i4)+input-norm(i5)+tomo-physics(i6), RAM is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on dense Mayo across ALL FIVE levers -> documented path to iter-20 as a structural negative. (6) verdict: this iter DOCUMENTS the ceiling. Budget: a boolean physics-path flag; the deepinv-tomo path adds a few physics evals per slice, but iters 3-5 ran 934.6-985.9s = 15.6-16.4 min for 214 single forward passes + one op-norm power iter, comfortable headroom under the HARD 1200s budget; sbatch --time=00:30:00 backstop wall (no in-solver wall knob in solver_ram.py). val_n stays 214 (score ALL L277 slices @ 321px detector-geometry FOV). HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted, per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe, val-only solver), bg_target=truth, 321px FOV DEFAULT (no fov=False).
